source: The word "Tensor Core" also hides generational change. Earlier ZXNAME0000XZ interfaces exposed warp-level matrix operations. Hopper introduced asynchronous warpgroup MMA instructions for certain high-performance paths, where four contiguous warps cooperate as a warpgroup. Datacenter Blackwell ZXNAME0001XZ adds newer tcgen05.mma instructions and Tensor Memory (TMEM) for parts of the matrix pipeline.[6,11]
zh: “Tensor Core”这个词也隐藏着代际更迭。早期的 ZXNAME0000XZ 接口公开了扭曲级矩阵运算。 Hopper 为某些高性能路径引入了异步 warpgroup MMA 指令，其中四个连续的 warp 作为一个 warpgroup 进行协作。数据中心 Blackwell ZXNAME0001XZ 为部分矩阵管道添加了更新的 tcgen05.mma 指令和张量内存 (TMEM)。[6,11]
